title: Freeze, Share, Shrink: Rethinking the Action Backbone in Diffusion Policies
abstract: arXiv:2511.12101v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Many recent Vision-Language-Action models employ diffusion or flow-matching backbones with hundreds of millions of parameters for action generation. However, unlike image synthesis where the output spans millions of diverse pixels, a manipulation policy generates only short sequences of low-dimensional, physically correlated action values, a far simpler target that may not require such capacity. We confirm this intuition and show that, in modulation-conditioned diffusion policies, task adaptation can be routed entirely through the conditioning pathway, leaving a frozen, observation-free backbone that serves as a reusable trajectory prior. To establish this, we introduce a decoupled training recipe: a general-purpose action head is first pretrained on observation-free forward-kinematics data, then frozen while only the conditioning pathway is trained for downstream tasks. translated_title: 冻结、共享、精简：重新思考扩散策略中的动作骨干网络
translated_abstract: 许多近期的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型采用具有数亿参数的扩散或流匹配骨干网络来生成动作。然而，与图像合成需要输出数百万多样化像素不同，操作策略仅生成由低维、物理相关的动作值组成的短序列——这是一个简单得多的目标，可能并不需要如此大的模型容量。我们证实了这一直觉，并证明在调制条件化的扩散策略中，任务适应可以完全通过条件化通路来完成，从而保留一个冻结的、不依赖观测输入的骨干网络，作为可复用的轨迹先验。为确立这一点，我们提出了一种解耦训练方案：首先在无观测输入的正向运动学数据上预训练一个通用动作头，随后将其冻结，在下游任务中仅训练条件化通路。以Diffusion Policy作为测试平台，我们表明在……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 扩散策略的动作骨干网络可在无观测运动学数据上预训练后冻结复用，下游任务适应仅需训练条件化通路即可完成，表明动作生成无需庞大参数量。
en_tdlr: The action backbone in diffusion policies can be pretrained on observation-free kinematics data, frozen, and reused, with downstream task adaptation achieved entirely through training only the conditioning pathway.
